cards.title: Odisha lateral entry to B.Tech: who can apply
cards.rule: A 3-year (or 2-year lateral-entry) diploma in any branch of engineering/technology with at least 45% (40% for reserved categories); or a B.Sc. with 45% (40%) and Mathematics in 10+2; or D.Voc in the same/allied sector. B.Sc. candidates are considered only after diploma candidates fill the supernumerary seats.
cards.section: Eligibility table, row 5 "LE-TECH", printed pp.18-19 (PDF pp.21-22)
cards.confirmNote: Confirm in this year's official notice before acting.

cards.title: Odisha lateral entry is for Odisha natives only
cards.rule: Outside-state candidates (ZZ) are not eligible for any lateral-entry programme. Reservations apply only to Odisha natives, who must produce an online resident/nativity certificate from an Odisha competent authority.
cards.confirmNote: Confirm in this year's official notice before acting.

cards.title: No category reservation in Odisha lateral entry
cards.rule: There is no reservation category for any lateral-entry course except for persons with disability and carried-over EWS vacant seats.
cards.confirmNote: Confirm in this year's official notice before acting.

cards.title: Odisha tuition fee waiver seats (TFW)
cards.rule: Up to 5% of sanctioned intake per course (supernumerary, as per AICTE) for B.Tech, B.Pharm, MBA, MCA and lateral entry. Family income from all sources must be under Rs 8 lakh. An income certificate from the Tahasildar and an online resident certificate are required, and they must be of the 2025-26 financial year.
cards.confirmNote: Confirm in this year's official notice before acting.

cards.title: JoSAA: Class XII performance needed for IIT/NIT+ admission
cards.rule: Pass Class XII with at least five subjects and either score at least 75% aggregate (65% for SC, ST, PwD) or be in the category-wise top 20 percentile of your board for that year. The five subjects are Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics, a language and one other subject. Improvement-exam rules differ: for the percentile route you must reappear in all subjects. Marksheets from different boards cannot be combined.
cards.confirmNote: Confirm in this year's official notice before acting.

cards.title: JoSAA: accepting a seat means choosing Freeze, Float or Slide
cards.rule: To stay in the process you must accept the allotted seat and choose Freeze (keep this seat, no upgrades), Float (keep it but consider higher choices anywhere) or Slide (keep it but consider higher choices in the same institute). Then upload documents and pay the seat acceptance fee.
cards.section: Section XX clause 48; online reporting steps, PDF pp.41 and 54
cards.confirmNote: Confirm in this year's official notice before acting.

cards.title: JoSAA: an unpaid seat acceptance fee cancels the seat for good
cards.rule: If the seat acceptance fee is not paid and updated on the portal within the round's time, the seat may be cancelled. "Such cancellation is not reversible and no requests would be entertained."
cards.confirmNote: Confirm in this year's official notice before acting.

cards.title: JoSAA: withdrawing a seat ends your JoSAA counselling
cards.rule: Withdrawal is allowed from round 2 up to the second-last round for IIT/IISc seats (till the end of the NIT+ online rounds). The seat is cancelled, you are excluded from all later JoSAA rounds, and the fee is refunded minus a Rs 7,000 processing charge. Withdrawal needs a signed declaration and OTP; it can be cancelled only before the reporting officer accepts it.
cards.confirmNote: Confirm in this year's official notice before acting.

cards.title: JoSAA: a seat given in the last round counts as accepted
cards.rule: If you had no seat up to round 4, did not use Exit before round 5, and get a seat in round 5, you are deemed to have accepted it and become ineligible for JEE (Advanced) 2027. Join round 5 only if you would accept any seat on your list.
cards.confirmNote: Confirm in this year's official notice before acting.

cards.title: Accepting a JoSAA seat blocks next year's JEE (Advanced)
cards.rule: A candidate who has accepted a seat in JoSAA 2026 is not eligible for JEE (Advanced) 2027, even if they do not report to the institute or attend classes.
cards.confirmNote: Confirm in this year's official notice before acting.

cards.title: JoSAA: OBC-NCL / EWS certificate date
cards.rule: For OBC-NCL or GEN-EWS, the certificate must be issued on or after 1 April 2026, or be a government-issued, online-verifiable certificate valid till the date stated in the rules (the NIT+ and IIT annexures state different dates).
cards.confirmNote: Confirm in this year's official notice before acting.
cards.notes: This is JoSAA's 2026 rule. Other counselling bodies set their own windows; do not apply it to them.

cards.title: JoSAA: a missing or invalid category certificate
cards.rule: If a category certificate is invalid or not produced in the reporting period and the seat was allotted in that category, the seat is cancelled and you are considered as GEN in later rounds. If the seat was in the OPEN category, it is provisionally confirmed. Wilful forgery leads to debarment.
cards.confirmNote: Confirm in this year's official notice before acting.

cards.title: JoSAA: Class XII result revised after choice locking
cards.rule: If re-evaluation makes you ineligible, the seat is cancelled even at a later stage. If it makes you eligible, email the organising institute with the revised certificate by the stated deadline (15 July 2026); you are considered only in later rounds and only if you had registered and filled choices.
cards.confirmNote: Confirm in this year's official notice before acting.

cards.title: NEET UG (MCC): leaving a seat from round 2 onward loses the deposit
cards.rule: Round 1: free exit. If you are allotted a seat in round 2 or later and do not join, the security deposit is forfeited. It is also forfeited if admission is cancelled for any reason, such as wrong registration information or missing documents. After joining a round 3 seat you cannot resign.
cards.confirmNote: Confirm in this year's official notice before acting.
cards.notes: A revised bulletin dated 20-08-2026 exists; it was not compared. Check it before publishing.

cards.title: NEET UG (MCC): deemed university security amount
cards.rule: For deemed universities the candidate pays Rs 5,000 counselling/registration fee plus a Rs 2,00,000 security amount.
cards.confirmNote: Confirm in this year's official notice before acting.
cards.notes: Check the revised bulletin (20-08-2026) before publishing.

cards.title: SSC Junior Engineer: diploma routes
cards.rule: Posts are Group B, Level 6. Qualifications are post-wise: several posts accept a three-year diploma in the relevant branch; some (e.g. Border Roads) need a diploma plus two years of experience, others a degree. The qualification must be held by the closing date of the online form (22 September 2026).
cards.section: Para 2 posts and qualifications table, PDF p.3 onward
cards.confirmNote: Confirm in this year's official notice before acting.

cards.title: SSC: your result must be declared by the closing date
cards.rule: You meet the qualification only if your result was declared on or before the cut-off date and you were declared passed. "Mere processing of the result" by the institute does not count. Final-year students whose results come later are not eligible for this cycle.
cards.confirmNote: Confirm in this year's official notice before acting.

cards.title: SSC JE: age limit
cards.rule: Age is counted on 1 August 2026. The upper limit is 30 or 32 years depending on the organisation, with relaxations by category. Category status is counted on the closing date of the online form.
cards.confirmNote: Confirm in this year's official notice before acting.

cards.title: Apprenticeship: minimum monthly stipend
cards.rule: Minimum stipend per month: Class 10 pass-outs Rs 8,200; Class 12 pass-outs Rs 9,600; National or State (ITI) certificate holders Rs 9,600; vocational/technician apprentices and diploma-institution sandwich students Rs 9,600; diploma holders and degree-institution sandwich students Rs 10,900; graduates Rs 12,300.
cards.confirmNote: Confirm in this year's official notice before acting.
cards.notes: Replaces older figures such as Rs 7,000 (2019). A DGT clarification on stipend rates (11 Sept 2025) could not be fetched: its site certificate is revoked.

cards.title: Apprenticeship: at most two trainings, different trades
cards.rule: A person may do at most two apprenticeship trainings, and the second cannot be in the same trade. The central government's stipend share is for the first training only.
cards.confirmNote: Confirm in this year's official notice before acting.

cards.title: ITI trainees can earn Class 10 / Class 12 through NIOS
cards.rule: Under the NIOS-DGT scheme, eligible Craftsmen Training Scheme (ITI) trainees can get Secondary or Senior Secondary equivalence while training. Trade subjects are credited, so 2-year trade trainees need one additional language subject and 1-year trade trainees need two additional subjects. Study happens at approved ITIs.
cards.governingBody: Directorate General of Training (DGT) with NIOS
cards.document: DGT scheme page "Creating Career Pathways through Academic Equivalence"
cards.confirmNote: Confirm in this year's official notice before acting.
cards.notes: The scheme FAQ and brochure (July 2026) give more detail, including a 2-year gestation rule for Class XII via 1-year trades; that detail came only via search summaries and needs reading from the FAQ PDF.

cards.title: Check UGC's list of fake universities
cards.rule: Before admission, check the institution against UGC's current "List of Fake Universities". The list changes over time; the app links to it and shows the date it was checked, and never stores a count.
cards.confirmNote: Open the live list; do not rely on any cached count.
cards.notes: The page loads its list through a script that could not be read automatically.

cards.title: RRB Assistant Loco Pilot 2026 (CEN 01/2026)
cards.rule: Not verified. The official notice is hosted on RRB sites whose security certificates are revoked or expired, so it could not be read safely. Secondary sources disagree on the age limit (28 vs 30).
cards.confirmNote: Do not show eligibility from this card until the notice is read.

cards.title: Diploma holders can enter year 2 of an engineering degree
cards.rule: AICTE's handbook provides second-year engineering degree admission for qualifying diploma holders. Seats, marks, branch mapping and domicile are set by the state admission authority and institution each cycle.
cards.confirmNote: Confirm in this year's official notice before acting.

cards.title: Class 10 + two-year ITI can enter year 2 of a diploma
cards.rule: AICTE lists Class 10 plus a two-year ITI qualification as an entry route into second-year engineering/technology diploma, with bridge courses where appropriate.
cards.confirmNote: Confirm in this year's official notice before acting.

cards.title: Railway technician posts accept NCVT or SCVT
cards.rule: RRB CEN 02/2025 (Technician) lists accepted qualifications post by post and trade by trade; listed Grade III roles accept ITI certificates from NCVT or SCVT. "SCVT will not be enough" is false as a universal statement.
cards.confirmNote: Confirm in this year's official notice before acting.

cards.title: NAPS-2 stipend support does not cover government employers
cards.rule: NAPS-2 gives partial stipend support through DBT; central/state government departments and PSUs are not eligible for this funding support.
cards.confirmNote: Confirm in this year's official notice before acting.

cards.title: JEE MAIN: who can sit the exam
cards.rule: Class XII passed in 2024/2025 or appearing in 2026. Exam entry and NIT+ admission are separate; programme subjects, qualifying year and counselling rules must be checked.
cards.confirmNote: Confirm in this year's official notice before acting.

cards.title: JEE ADVANCED: who can sit the exam
cards.rule: Indian/OCI(I) route: JEE Main top-250000 shortlist; at most two attempts in consecutive years; first Class XII appearance normally 2025/2026 with PCM, with specified exceptions and earlier IIT-admission restrictions. IIT admission marks are separate from permission to appear.

cards.title: NEET UG: who can sit the exam
cards.rule: Physics, Chemistry, Biology/Biotechnology and English are required through the recognised qualifying route, including permitted additional-subject routes. Class XII appearing candidates are provisional. The old unscoped aggregate 50/40 marks gate is withdrawn pending applicable NMC/admission-rule review; this does not assert that admission has no marks conditions. NEET qualifying percentile is a separate rule.

cards.title: CLAT: who can sit the exam
cards.rule: UG route only: 10+2 passed or 2026 appearing provisionally. Consortium lists 45%, or 40% for SC/ST/PwD. NLU-specific admission documents must also be checked; NLSIU brochure lists only SC/ST relaxation, so PwD admission scope needs clarification. CLAT 2026 was scheduled for 7 December 2025, not December 2026.

cards.title: CUET: who can sit the exam
cards.rule: Class XII/equivalent passed or appearing in 2026; NTA has no age limit, but universities may. Up to five test subjects. University/programme subject mapping and admission eligibility remain separate from test appearance.
cards.confirmNote: Confirm in this year's official notice before acting.

cards.rule: Eligible degree students in third year or higher, or completed government-approved degrees in the listed disciplines; special degree/equivalence routes have their own conditions. GATE qualification does not guarantee admission, scholarship or PSU recruitment.

cards.title: CAT: who can sit the exam
cards.rule: Bachelor degree/equivalent with 50%, or 45% SC/ST/PwBD; final-year/awaiting-result applicants can apply provisionally. Specified completed CA/CS/CMA/FIAI qualifications are alternate routes. University-certified CGPA conversion and institute-specific shortlisting/admission criteria apply.

cards.title: UGC NET: who can sit the exam
cards.rule: Masters route: 55% General/EWS, 50% OBC-NCL/SC/ST/PwD/PwBD/third gender; provisional candidates have completion deadlines. Four-year bachelor route: 75% with notified 5% relaxation, including final-year provisional candidates; this route permits JRF/PhD, not Assistant Professor. A single masters marks gate cannot describe both routes.
